$comment: Pre-market focus engine configuration (2026-10-06, workstream D, local-only). ALL operational numbers for the pre-market opportunity score and focus report live here, never as TypeScript literals (repo AGENTS.md: no hardcoded operational thresholds in TS). Read by src/server/premarket/PremarketOpportunityScore.ts (scoring) and src/server/premarket/PremarketFocusReport.ts (tiering) via src/server/config/premarketFocus.ts, which validates this file at load. Tests derive expected values from this same file.

docs.refreshWindow: Informational: the late-refresh window (America/Toronto) that workstream B's refresh targets. The report records which refreshVersion it was built from; the window itself gates nothing in this module.
docs.report: maxSymbolsPerTier: cap per tier in the persisted report (overflow beyond the cap is dropped lowest-total-first and counted in metrics). topContributionsKept: how many per-component contributions the PREMARKET_CANDIDATE_SCORED payload carries (bounded observability). roundDecimals: rounding for emitted/persisted score numbers.
docs.scales: Normalization caps. gapScaleCapPct: |overnight gap| >= 5% scores 1.0 (matches ComposableRanking GAP_SCALE_CAP_PCT and the discovery gapMover tag threshold). preMarketScaleCapPct: symmetric with gap. catalystRecencyZeroAtMinutes: linear decay — a catalyst 720 minutes (12h) old scores 0 for recency; pre-market review is about today's news. liquidityScaleDollars: matches ComposableRanking LIQUIDITY_SCALE_CAP_DOLLARS ($50M). advLiquidityScaleShares: 4x the broad-universe ADV floor (continuousIntelligence.broadUniverseMinAvgDailyVolumeShares = 500k) — full liquidity score at genuinely liquid names. spreadZeroAtBps: spread >= 50bps scores 0 quality, linear below. strategyFullCount: >= 3 applicable strategies scores 1.0.
docs.sentimentAloneCeiling: Documented ceiling for the contextual sentiment component: the signedSentiment component can contribute at most +/- this to the total (it equals weights.signedSentiment because the component itself is bounded to [-1,1]; validated at load). Extreme sentiment with no other evidence can therefore never push the total above this ceiling, and sentiment never creates a direction — enforced by PremarketOpportunityScore.test.ts.
docs.tierCutoffs: Attention tiers for the focus report. Tiers mean 'deserves attention in the pre-market review', NEVER 'actionable' — the report emits no trade ideas and never touches ChiefTrader/RiskEngine/OMS. primary 0.70: needs broad evidence across components. secondary 0.50: at least half the weighted evidence. watch 0.30: non-trivial signal worth a glance. Below watch: REJECTED (not worth pre-market attention). Must be strictly ordered 1 > primary > secondary > watch > 0 (validated at load).
docs.weights: Component weights for the pre-market opportunity score. Must sum to exactly 1.0 (validated at load). Rationale: overnightGap + preMarketPctChange (0.15 each) are the primary pre-market attention drivers and are scored direction-blind (magnitude only) — this is an attention ranking, not a direction signal. catalystPresence (0.15) — a real catalyst is the strongest single reason a symbol deserves pre-market review. catalystRecency (0.10) — fresh catalysts matter more than stale ones. signedSentiment (0.10) — CONTEXTUAL only: sentiment * confidence in [-1,1]; it may modestly raise or lower the attention total but must never convert into a directional trigger (the breakdown carries no side/direction field by design). liquidity (0.10) — illiquid names are not worth attention regardless of signal. spreadQuality (0.05) — wide spreads erode any setup; an explicitly-unknown spread is fail-open (neutral), never penalized. sectorRelativeStrength / marketRelativeStrength (0.05 each) — context only, and small because sector/market-basket evidence is often honestly unavailable. strategyApplicability (0.10) — a symbol with a valid pre-market setup for known strategies deserves more attention.
